description: Independent generalization checks with new prompts and data: 5 single-turn and 5 multi-turn cases. Expectations follow declared tool contracts; this dataset is separate from the fixed base and group datasets.

cases.query: Cho tôi xem 4 bài đăng gần đây do tài khoản X @linuxfoundation viết.

metadata.what_it_tests: Use the handle explicitly supplied by the user, strip @ and preserve the requested count without resolving a proper name.

metadata.what_it_tests: Search posts about a supplied keyword across authors, with the Top enum and explicit result count.

metadata.what_it_tests: An article-reading request without a URL must call clarify, without guessing a URL or silently answering in prose.

metadata.what_it_tests: An implementation request outside the research tool scope must not trigger research or clarification tools. The existing scorer checks no-tool routing, not refusal wording.
